cohort: Participants in three birth cohort studies from Pelotas, Brazil (born in 1982, 1993, and 2004)
finding: The study found no consistent association between caesarian section and fat mass index or BMI z-score at ages 6, 18, and 30 years, except for a potential association in women at age 30.
mod_finding: This study found no consistent association between Cesarean section and fat mass index or BMI z-score at ages 6, 18, and 30 years, except for women at age 30, where C-section was associated with higher fat mass index and BMI z-score.
